purpose: Make Hakim the top-level phone-oriented execution layer while preserving Android platform protection, free-first routing, least privilege, explicit field evidence and truthful capability boundaries.

control_tiers.name: direct_connected_services
control_tiers.scope: Authorized connectors that complete account tasks without phone UI automation

control_tiers.name: hakim_android_safe_core
control_tiers.scope: Local Android app with INTERNET only; free/public mission fetch, safe URL open, visible status and sanitized report relay; no Accessibility, screen reading, hidden typing or hidden clicking
control_tiers.field_requirement: actual install + open + safe mission roundtrip on phone

control_tiers.name: accessibility_automation_experimental
control_tiers.scope: Frozen. Previous sideloaded Accessibility design was blocked by Play Protect on the user's phone and is not a default route.

control_tiers.name: authorized_device_terminal
control_tiers.scope: Filesystem/process execution through Remote Desktop Commander when its phone endpoint is online
control_tiers.field_requirement: device online plus harmless command PASS

control_tiers.name: termux_shizuku_shell
control_tiers.scope: Optional local non-root shell automation only after explicit on-device enablement

control_tiers.name: screen_capture_when_needed
control_tiers.scope: Android MediaProjection only with fresh per-session user consent

control_tiers.name: root_device_control
control_tiers.scope: Not required and not pursued by default
control_tiers.field_requirement: separate explicit user decision and safety review

routing_order: Use a direct authorized connector when it completes the goal without phone UI automation.
For the current phone field qualification, use HAKIM Android SAFE CORE only.
Never request disabling Play Protect or re-enable the Accessibility-based candidate automatically.
Use Remote Desktop Commander only when the registered device is actually online.
Use Termux/Shizuku only after explicit local enablement and separate qualification.
Do not use metered cloud-browser routes without a specific explicit paid-operation approval.

security_boundaries.safe_core_permissions: INTERNET only; no AccessibilityService, no screen-reading permission, no contacts/SMS/camera/microphone/location/storage management
security_boundaries.safe_core_actions: OPEN_URL, WAIT, STATUS and REPORT only
security_boundaries.passwords_otp_recovery: never placed in public missions or reports
security_boundaries.system_privilege: no silent root, developer-mode enablement, Play Protect bypass or permission escalation
security_boundaries.high_impact: delete, purchase, payment, transfer, account removal, publication and external message send stay outside remote safe-core scope
